_source_note: Rebuilt from real Tinkerer leveling-guide screenshots (Kyle: 'This document is RIGHT from wow when I logged in. It's 100% accurate.', level-1 character). Every ability below traces to one specific screenshot. Real gating rule confirmed by Kyle: level/SpecName(N) text in a tooltip is NOT a real requirement (cosmetic UI chrome for whichever spec tab was open on a level-1 character with 0 points everywhere) - the ONLY real requirement signal is a '(Rank N)' suffix in an ability's own displayed name, and only for the specific abilities Kyle confirmed directly: Bomb Toss, Rocket Launcher, Nanobot Reconstruction, Stim Rounds, Med Pack, My Greatest Invention, Zap!, Nanobot Swarm, Makeshift Dynamite, Mechsuit: Laser Beam, Mechsuit: Combustion - these carry requires_talent=true and are granted by a real talent node (see data/talents/tinker_*.json), everything else is a plain level-gated class ability. Rocket Launcher's talent lives in Invention despite Rocket Launcher itself reading as a Demolition-flavored ability - real cross-tree case, screenshot-confirmed.

abilities.name: Build: Mechsuit
abilities.description: Don a powered Mechsuit for 15 sec: gain +10% damage dealt, +800 Armor, and +15% movement speed, and gain access to Mechsuit: Laser Beam and Mechsuit: Combustion.
abilities._source: Real screenshot-adjacent - the leveling doc doesn't show this activation ability directly, but Mechsuit: Laser Beam/Combustion both explicitly require an active Mechsuit state ('Shares a cooldown with other Mechsuit abilities'). Real CoA tooltip (earlier session): 'Activate your Mechsuit, draining 5 Scrap every sec... If you run out of Scrap while active, you are ejected.' Scrap-per-turn drain not yet wired (see _implementation_note) - modeled as a flat 15-turn duration for now. Granted by a Mechanics talent node (tier 3). Kyle: 'we can just make them form locked, likely easier' - this ability's real StatusEffect (effect_id = its own ability_id, "tinker_mechsuit_form") is exactly what Character.current_mechsuit checks for.
abilities._implementation_note: Real Scrap-per-turn drain (5/turn, early-eject if it hits 0) is not yet wired into the combat tick loop - flagging rather than silently dropping. Needs a per-turn hook similar to tick_out_of_combat_regen that decrements current_scrap while this buff is active and force-expires it early if current_scrap reaches 0.
